verses.text: Praise Yah! Praise, you servants of Yahweh, praise Yahweh’s name.
Blessed be Yahweh’s name, from this time forward and forever more.
lines: from this time forward and forever more.

verses.text: From the rising of the sun to its going down, Yahweh’s name is to be praised.
lines: From the rising of the sun to its going down,
Yahweh’s name is to be praised.

verses.text: Yahweh is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.
lines: Yahweh is high above all nations,

verses.text: Who is like Yahweh, our God, who has his seat on high,
lines: Who is like Yahweh, our God,
who has his seat on high,

verses.text: Who stoops down to see in heaven and in the earth?
lines: Who stoops down to see in heaven and in the earth?

verses.text: He raises up the poor out of the dust. Lifts up the needy from the ash heap,
lines: He raises up the poor out of the dust.
Lifts up the needy from the ash heap,

verses.text: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
lines: that he may set him with princes,
even with the princes of his people.

verses.text: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise Yah!
lines: He settles the barren woman in her home
as a joyful mother of children.
